title: Crispy Tofu Sandwiches with Garlic Aioli & Arugula-Cucumber Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu into ½-inch thick planks along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for the dressing). Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the aioli.

Place tofu on the baking sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon aioli over top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs, and drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with 1 tablespoon aioli, remaining bread crumbs, and remaining oil. (Reserve remaining aioli for sandwiches.)
Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning once, until the breading is crispy and golden brown, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice the lemon into a large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
Spread the remaining aioli over both halves of each bun. Layer each with a small portion of salad (reserving the rest for serving) and crispy tofu.
To serve, divide sandwiches and reserved salad between plates. Enjoy!
